## Contribution checklist

<!--
Full guidance:
https://docs.n8n.io/contribute/contribution-guide-for-n8n-docs
https://docs.n8n.io/contribute/contribution-guide-for-n8n-docs/style-guide-for-n8n-docs
-->

- [ ] This isn't an [unaccepted submission type](https://docs.n8n.io/contribute/contribution-guide-for-n8n-docs#what-not-to-submit) (promotional/commercial content, personal preference edits, or changes to a page with `generated: true` in its frontmatter).
- [ ] Writing follows the [style guide](https://docs.n8n.io/contribute/contribution-guide-for-n8n-docs/style-guide-for-n8n-docs): plain, concise language; active voice; second person ("you"); correct terminology and capitalization.
- [ ] New pages are added to the space's `SUMMARY.md` so they appear in the sidebar navigation.
- [ ] Images are stored in the space's `.gitbook/assets/` folder and have descriptive alt text; no instructions are shown only in a screenshot.
- [ ] All links work and point to the right location (internal links use the correct relative-path or space-URL format).
- [ ] I've run Vale prose linting (`vale docs/`), if contributing from a local clone, and addressed its errors and warnings as far as possible.
- [ ] I've read and accept the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and [Contributor License Agreement](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTOR_LICENSE_AGREEMENT.md).
